title: Vector Geometry: Expressing Vectors and Proving Parallel Lines
seo_title: Sec 4 Vector geometry Worksheets: Free Secondary 4 Maths with Answers (MOE Syllabus)
standard_text: use of sum and difference of two vectors to express given vectors in terms of two coplanar vectors; geometric problems involving the use of vectors
meta_desc: Free Secondary 4 maths worksheets on vector geometry: expressing vectors in terms of a and b, midpoints, ratios, extended lines, parallel vectors, collinear points and area ratios. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Follow a route: AB = AO + OB = −a + b.
key_sub: PQ = k RS means PQ is parallel to RS and k times as long.
body_html:
How it works

  • Follow a route along known vectors: AB = AO + OB = −a + b.
  • If P is on AB with AP : PB = m : n, then AP = m/(m + n) AB.
  • If PQ = k RS, then PQ is parallel to RS and k times as long.
  • If OQ = k OP, then O, P and Q are collinear (on one straight line).
Example

OA = a, OB = b and M is the midpoint of AB. Find OM.

AB = b − a

OM = OA + ½AB = a + ½(b − a)

Answer: ½a + ½b

Example

PQ = 6a + 3b and RS = 2a + b. Compare PQ and RS.

6a + 3b = 3(2a + b)

Answer: PQ is parallel to RS and 3 times as long

Common mistakes

  • Writing a − b for AB. Go from A back to O, then to B: −a + b.
  • Using the fraction from the wrong end of the line.
  • Saying parallel vectors are equal. They can have different lengths.
  • Using the length ratio for an area ratio without checking the heights.

faq.q: How do you express a vector in terms of a and b?
faq.a: Find a route from the start point to the end point along vectors you know, then add them, using a minus sign when you go against a vector.

faq.q: How do you find the vector to a point that divides a line in a ratio?
faq.a: If AP : PB = m : n, then AP = m/(m + n) of AB, so OP = OA + m/(m + n) AB.

faq.q: How do you show that three points are collinear?
faq.a: Show that two vectors joining them are scalar multiples of each other and share a common point, for example OQ = 3 OP.

faq.q: What does PQ = k RS tell you?
faq.a: PQ is parallel to RS and k times as long. If k is negative, it points the opposite way.
